name: InfiniteMarquee
description: Seamless looping ticker marquee supporting configurable direction, speed, gap spacing, pause-on-hover, and aria-hidden track duplication without layout jumps.
a11yNotes: Marks the duplicated second track aria-hidden='true' so screen readers only read the item list once, and pauses translation automatically on hover, focus-within, or prefers-reduced-motion.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.description: Array of labels or badges to scroll seamlessly.

propsApi.name: speed
propsApi.description: Duration in seconds for one complete loop.

propsApi.name: gap
propsApi.description: Gap in pixels between consecutive items.

propsApi.name: pauseOnHover
propsApi.description: Pauses the marquee when hovered or focused.
